name: realmforge
description: RPG multiplayer web com mapas 2D e mundos persistentes

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @realmforge/contracts && concurrently -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w @realmforge/api" "npm run dev -w @realmforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @realmforge/contracts && npm run build -w @realmforge/api && npm run build -w @realmforge/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @realmforge/contracts && npm run build -w @realmforge/api && npm run test -w @realmforge/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @realmforge/contracts && npm run build -w @realmforge/api && npm run typecheck -w @realmforge/web
